title: FRED Yield Curve Tracker
description: Tracks U.S. Treasury yields across key maturities (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 20Y, 30Y) and calculates critical spread signals. The 10Y-2Y spread inverting has predicted every U.S. recession since 1955. Also tracks the 10Y-3M spread (the Fed's preferred recession indicator) and the 2Y-Fed Funds spread. An inverted curve means bond markets expect rate cuts - historically the strongest macro signal available.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('DGS1MO', '1_month'),
    ('DGS3MO', '3_month'),
    ('DGS6MO', '6_month'),
    ('DGS1', '1_year'),
    ('DGS2', '2_year'),
    ('DGS5', '5_year'),
    ('DGS10', '10_year'),
    ('DGS20', '20_year'),
    ('DGS30', '30_year'),
]

yields = {}
for i in range(len(SERIES)):
    series_id = SERIES[i][0]
    label = SERIES[i][1]
    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 1,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])
    if obs and obs[0].get('value', '.') != '.':
        yields[label] = float(obs[0]['value'])
    else:
        yields[label] = None

# Calculate key spreads
y10 = yields.get('10_year')
y2 = yields.get('2_year')
y3m = yields.get('3_month')
y30 = yields.get('30_year')

spread_10y_2y = round(y10 - y2, 4) if y10 is not None and y2 is not None else None
spread_10y_3m = round(y10 - y3m, 4) if y10 is not None and y3m is not None else None
spread_30y_10y = round(y30 - y10, 4) if y30 is not None and y10 is not None else None

is_inverted_10y2y = spread_10y_2y < 0 if spread_10y_2y is not None else False
is_inverted_10y3m = spread_10y_3m < 0 if spread_10y_3m is not None else False

if is_inverted_10y2y and is_inverted_10y3m:
    signal = 'STRONG_RECESSION_WARNING'
elif is_inverted_10y2y or is_inverted_10y3m:
    signal = 'RECESSION_WATCH'
else:
    signal = 'NORMAL'

rows = [{
    'yield_1m': yields.get('1_month'),
    'yield_3m': yields.get('3_month'),
    'yield_6m': yields.get('6_month'),
    'yield_1y': yields.get('1_year'),
    'yield_2y': yields.get('2_year'),
    'yield_5y': yields.get('5_year'),
    'yield_10y': yields.get('10_year'),
    'yield_20y': yields.get('20_year'),
    'yield_30y': yields.get('30_year'),
    'spread_10y_2y': spread_10y_2y,
    'spread_10y_3m': spread_10y_3m,
    'spread_30y_10y': spread_30y_10y,
    'is_inverted_10y2y': is_inverted_10y2y,
    'is_inverted_10y3m': is_inverted_10y3m,
    'curve_signal': signal,
    '_epoch': now_epoch,
}]

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
